name: Mari El (Mari SSR, 1990–1992)
description: A red field with a blue vertical stripe at the hoist, a yellow hammer and sickle beneath a yellow-bordered red star in the upper hoist, and the inscription 'Марийская ССР / Марий ССР' in Russian and Mari in yellow.
history: The RSFSR-pattern flag of the Mari ASSR with the inscription changed after the republic declared itself the Mari SSR in October 1990. It was replaced in 1992 by the first flag of the Republic of Mari El.

features.role: inscription 'Марийская ССР / Марий ССР' in Russian and Mari
